# DandyLions hub (full)

Source: https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/ (public, read-only, maintained by Ruben Bijker). Updated 2026-10-08.
Contents: design tokens, template images and brand assets. There is no copywriting guidance in this hub. The text inside template images is sample text from the Figma file.

## How to use (for Claude)

You have read-only access to the DandyLions hub, a public website with the DandyLions design tokens, template images and brand assets.

1. At the start of a task, fetch https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/llms-full.txt. It lists the design tokens and every image and asset with its absolute URL, format, size and a visual description.
2. For colours, fonts, sizes and spacing, use https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/design-system/tokens.json.
   Type scale: 28 and up gets a mobile size, everything else doesn't, and only the wordmark and reading text scale smoothly.
3. For a social post, slide, newsletter or other visual, the matching template images are a good source of inspiration. Open them by URL and borrow from their layout, colour, type and graphic devices, treating them as reference rather than something to copy exactly.
4. For logos and icons, use the files listed under Logos and Icons. SVGs are plain text: fetch the raw.githubusercontent.com URL to read the markup. Use the charcoal versions on ivory and the ivory versions on sage.
5. Where possible, use the real DandyLions logos, icons and graphics from the hub; they're the best starting point. If something you need isn't there, it helps to mention it, since Ruben looks after the hub and can add it.
6. The hub contains no copywriting guidance. The text inside the template images is sample text only.

## Design tokens: css-tokens.json (raw snapshot of the website's CSS variables, synced daily)

URL: https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/design-system/css-tokens.json

```json

      "font-family": "var(--font-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif",
      "font-weight": "400",
      "font-size": "13px",
      "line-height": "20px",
      "letter-spacing": "0"
    },
    "type-overline": {
      "font-family": "var(--font-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif",
      "font-weight": "400",
      "font-size": "11px",
      "line-height": "20px",
      "letter-spacing": "2.4px",
      "text-transform": "uppercase"
    },
    "type-wordmark": {
      "font-family": "var(--font-serif), ui-serif, Georgia, serif",
      "font-weight": "300",
      "font-size": "clamp(34px, 6vw, 84px)",
      "line-height": "0.95",
      "letter-spacing": "-0.035em"
    },
    "type-route": {
      "font-family": "var(--font-serif), ui-serif, Georgia, serif",
      "font-weight": "400",
      "font-size": "46px",
      "line-height": "58px",
      "letter-spacing": "-0.46px"
    }
  }
}
```

## Icons (design-system icon set)

Line icons. Strokes and fills use currentColor; the root sets color="#2D2D2D" (charcoal). On sage, use ivory #F5F2EC. Accent badge colours: sage muted #7C866D, wine #632631, ochre #AA8653, forest #183930.

## Graphic devices and textures

### Dandelion seed head
- URL: https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/assets/svg/seed-head.svg
- Raw SVG text: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rbijkercom/dandylions-hub/main/assets/svg/seed-head.svg
- Format: SVG, viewBox 0 0 527.5 493.4
- Looks like: Gold #907948 line drawing of a dandelion seed head at 60% opacity.
- Background: Ivory or sage
- Use: Graphic device: large, cropped off an edge, 20 to 60% opacity.
- Source: Figma file ADAT7igJnBG5nvij5shy9V, node 372:16767 (Social media pack › IG Post 03 › Seed head)

### Drifting seed
- URL: https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/assets/svg/drifting-seed.svg
- Raw SVG text: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rbijkercom/dandylions-hub/main/assets/svg/drifting-seed.svg
- Format: SVG, viewBox 0 0 36 94
- Looks like: Single gold #907948 dandelion seed at 60% opacity.
- Background: Ivory or sage
- Use: Graphic device: 2 to 4 per layout, rising away from the seed head.
- Source: Figma file ADAT7igJnBG5nvij5shy9V, node 372:16770 (Social media pack › IG Post 03 › Drifting seed)

### Paper grain texture
- URL: https://rbijkercom.github.io/dandylions-hub/assets/graphics/paper-grain.png
- Format: PNG, 300 x 300 px
- Looks like: Seamless paper-grain noise tile (300 x 300).
- Background: Overlay on ivory and sage at about 3.5% opacity
- Use: Background texture.
- Source: rbijkercom/dandy-lions: public/brand/grain.png
